decision.text: CZ1: a fixed zstd level beat PR #34's automatic choice at 10 GbE: confirm it, and the policy needs another look (large-text mac→apollo xs-rs-z1 2.20× [0.27, 18.04]; large-text mac→apollo xs-rs-z3 1.41× [0.11, 18.04]; large-text apollo→mac xs-rs-z3 1.17× [0.86, 1.59]; real-congress mac→apollo xs-rs-z3 1.15× [0.29, 4.52]; 2 more)

RW7: xs with --whole-file beat rsync's delta at 10 GbE: on a fast link xs should skip the delta; confirm (large-solo mac→apollo xs-cpp-W 2.66× [0.00, 11261.27]; hs-16x256m mac→apollo xs-rs-W 2.38× [0.00, 2255.51]; large-solo mac→apollo xs-cpp-W 2.30× [0.00, 657178.09]; large-text mac→apollo xs-cpp-W 1.83× [0.00, 1734.90]; 17 more)

RW8a: latency widens rsync's delta lead: xs's signature exchange costs round trips (large-text apollo→mac xs-rs 0.91× [0.45, 1.82]; hs-16x256m apollo→mac xs-rs 0.86× [0.82, 0.90]; hs-16x256m apollo→mac xs-rs 0.84× [0.67, 1.06]; hs-16x256m apollo→mac xs-cpp 0.84× [0.63, 1.11]; 13 more)

RW8b: on a slow path rsync's delta beats xs: xs must send less when bytes are the limit; a code case (large-text apollo→mac xs-rs 0.85× [0.77, 0.94]; large-text apollo→mac xs-rs 0.80× [0.71, 0.90]; large-text apollo→mac xs-cpp 0.52× [0.51, 0.52]; large-text mac→apollo xs-cpp 0.47× [0.01, 27.43]; 1 more)
PR1: PR #34 is slower than its base in some cell: confirm on fresh blocks before merging (hs-16x256m apollo→mac xs-rs 0.82× [0.29, 2.34]; local-laikav2 apollo→mac xs-rs 0.81× [0.30, 2.18])
CZ2: at 1 Gb/s a fixed level beat the automatic one: the rate rule's thresholds need moving (large-text apollo→mac xs-rs-z3 1.44× [1.44, 1.44]; large-text mac→apollo xs-rs-z3 1.15× [0.00, 429.31])

CZ3: at 100 Mb/s a fixed level beat the automatic one: the policy should climb sooner when bytes are the limit (real-congress mac→apollo xs-rs-z3 1.20× [1.00, 1.43]; real-congress mac→apollo xs-rs-z1 1.19× [0.58, 2.47])
CZ4: with 2 cores a fixed level beat the automatic one: the CPU veto misjudges this machine (large-text mac→apollo xs-rs-z1 1.44× [0.00, 772.06])

SM1: skipping the rename or more workers writes small files onto APFS faster: confirm (scale-count-1000000 apollo→mac xs-cpp-noatomic 1.76× [1.67, 1.86]; real-congress apollo→mac xs-cpp-noatomic 1.42× [1.38, 1.45]; real-congress apollo→mac xs-cpp-j8 1.18× [0.89, 1.58]; real-congress apollo→mac xs-cpp-noatomic 1.08× [0.71, 1.63])
